description: Inspect a vehicle's route in the Bologna Acosta traffic simulation using sumo-gui. The sumo-gui application is already open with the Bologna Acosta scenario loaded (real-world traffic network from the Acosta area in Bologna, Italy). The simulation is loaded but not yet started. Your task is to: 1. Start the simulation by pressing Ctrl+A to begin running it. Vehicles will appear on the roads. 2. After a few seconds of simulation, press Ctrl+A again to pause the simulation so you can interact with individual vehicles. 3. Right-click on any visible vehicle (small colored rectangle on the roads) in the simulation view. 4. In the context menu that appears, select 'Show Current Route' to highlight the vehicle's planned path on the map. 5. After the route is displayed (highlighted edges on the map), right-click the same vehicle again and select 'Show Parameters' or the parameter dialog option to open the vehicle's parameter window showing its speed, position, route, and other properties. The vehicle parameter dialog should be open and visible at the end.
